title: npm run lint fails in the main checkout whenever an agent worktree is live: biome finds the worktree's biome.json as a nested root config
description:
REPRODUCED 2026-09-17 in the main checkout while an opum-workflow implementer was running in .claude/worktrees/agent-<id>/.

  $ npm run lint
  x Found a nested root configuration, but there's already a root configuration.
  i The other configuration was found in /Volumes/external/repos/lore-cli.
  x Biome exited because the configuration resulted in errors.
  exit 1

The checkout's own files are clean: 'npx biome check src/tracker-migration.ts' exits 0. The failure is entirely biome walking into the live agent worktree and finding its copy of biome.json as a SECOND root config.

WHY NOTHING CAUGHT IT EARLIER. CI never sees it -- a fresh clone has no worktrees -- and an implementer running INSIDE its own worktree has no nested worktree below it, so it lints clean and reports lint 0 honestly. The only configuration that reproduces is a session linting the main checkout while an agent it dispatched is still running, which is now the normal shape of work in this repo.

WHY IT IS WORSE THAN A FALSE RED. The failure is a CONFIGURATION error, not a lint error, so it names no file in the diff under review. A reader who trusts the red can spend real time looking for a problem in their own change, or 'fix' something unrelated. It also disappears the moment the agent finishes and its worktree is removed, which makes it look intermittent.

ROOT CAUSE, MEASURED NOT GUESSED. biome.json sets vcs.useIgnoreFile: true, and .claude/worktrees/ IS ignored -- but via .git/info/exclude (line 11), not the committed .gitignore. Biome's ignore-file handling reads .gitignore; a local exclude is invisible to it. Separately, biome's nested-root-config DISCOVERY is not the same pass as files.includes (which is already scoped to src/test/benchmark/scripts/bin), so narrowing includes alone will not fix it.

CANDIDATE FIXES, to be decided rather than assumed: add .claude/worktrees/ to the committed .gitignore (check first why it lives in .git/info/exclude -- that may be deliberate and fleet-wide), and/or give biome an explicit ignore for .claude/** so config discovery cannot descend there regardless of ignore-file semantics. Prefer whichever makes the main checkout lint correctly WITH an agent live, since that is the state the defect occurs in -- and prove it that way, with an agent worktree present, not on a clean tree.

ACCEPTANCE SHAPE: 'npm run lint' exits 0 in the main checkout while a worktree containing biome.json exists under .claude/worktrees/, and still exits non-zero for a genuine lint violation in src/. Both halves measured, per the fleet rule that proving a gate rejects and proving it accepts are separate measurements.
plan: 1. Commit .claude/worktrees/ in .gitignore so biome (vcs.useIgnoreFile) stops descending into a live worktree copy of biome.json; the local .git/info/exclude is invisible to biome.
2. Pin it with a test asserting the committed rule AND biome vcs.useIgnoreFile, since CI cannot reproduce (a fresh clone has no worktrees).
3. Prove BOTH halves with a real worktree at .claude/worktrees/: lint exits 0 with it live, and still exits non-zero for a genuine src/ violation. Mutation-check the pin.
4. Gates: full bun test, npm run lint, typecheck, lore check. Review, record, land.
implementationNotes: Completed on branch fix/LCLI-520-worktree-nested-biome-config. ROOT CAUSE (measured, not guessed): biome.json sets vcs.useIgnoreFile, and biome reads .gitignore -- NOT .git/info/exclude, where **/.claude/worktrees/ actually lived (a LOCAL file biome cannot see). So biome descended into a live implementer worktree, found its copy of biome.json, and failed with "Found a nested root configuration" -- a CONFIGURATION error naming no file in the diff under review, which vanished when the worktree did and so looked intermittent. FIX: commit .claude/worktrees/ to .gitignore, in the existing .claude/ block and consistent with the other committed .claude/ runtime ignores; the local exclude is untouched. Chose this over a biome ignore stanza because the biome scanner includes pass does not govern config discovery (the task said so and the measurement agrees), whereas a committed ignore rule does. EVIDENCE, BOTH halves, against a REAL worktree at .claude/worktrees/repro-520: positive control BEFORE the fix exits 1 with the nested-root-config error; AFTER the fix, worktree still live, exits 0; and a genuine noUnusedVariables violation in src/ still exits 1 naming the file. Mechanism measured directly as well: a nested biome.json under the GITIGNORED .lore/cache/ is skipped (exit 0). GUARD: test/lcli520-worktree-nested-biome-config.test.ts pins the committed rule AND biome vcs.useIgnoreFile, because CI can never reproduce this (a fresh clone has no worktrees); renaming the rule reddens it (1 pass / 1 fail). GATES: full suite 4986 tests / 2 skip / 0 fail; lint, typecheck, lore check green.

ROUND-1 REVIEW (PR opum-ai/lore-cli#539) raised two MINOR findings, both addressed. (1) The guard asserted only vcs.useIgnoreFile; the reviewer MEASURED that vcs.enabled:false with useIgnoreFile:true brings the nested-root-config error BACK while that assertion stays green, so the guard could go green as the defect returned. It now asserts vcs.enabled, vcs.clientKind and vcs.useIgnoreFile, and setting enabled:false reddens it (1 pass / 1 fail). (2) The committed test pins the fixes INPUTS, not the end-to-end live-worktree measurement, which was made by hand and cannot be re-run without creating a worktree; the test comment now says that explicitly rather than implying the committed guard re-runs it.
finalSummary: npm run lint now exits 0 in the main checkout while a LIVE agent worktree exists under .claude/worktrees/. Root cause: biome.json sets vcs.useIgnoreFile and biome reads .gitignore, but .claude/worktrees/ was excluded only via the LOCAL .git/info/exclude, which biome cannot see -- so biome found the worktree copy of biome.json as a nested root config and failed with a configuration error naming no file in the diff, disappearing when the worktree did. Fix: commit .claude/worktrees/ to .gitignore. Verified BOTH halves against a real worktree at the defect path: pre-fix positive control exits 1 with the nested-root-config error, post-fix exits 0 with the worktree still live, and a genuine src/ violation still exits 1. Guarded by a new test pinning the ignore rule and biome vcs.useIgnoreFile, since CI cannot reproduce it; renaming the rule reddens it. Full suite 4986 tests / 2 skip / 0 fail; lint, typecheck and lore check green. Run job-11jahq7.
